note: Four flexible practice sessions; reschedule or replace with a round as needed. This is a provisional plan until Saturday review evidence and availability are confirmed.

sessions.title: Contact and long-approach calibration
sessions.purpose: Establish repeatable contact and current 150–180 yard evidence

blocks.name: Warm-up + arrival
blocks.instructions:
First 2 minutes — arrival routine:
30 seconds: Feel your feet; notice tension and your GREEN/YELLOW/RED state without judging it.
60 seconds: Breathe naturally. When expectations show up, acknowledge them and return attention to breathing.
30 seconds: Set the intention: “Some shots will miss. Choose, commit, then give the next shot my attention.”
Remaining 3 minutes — physical warm-up: Easy wedges and 8i; find balanced rhythm.

blocks.name: Low point
blocks.instructions: Slapshot rehearsals then 9-to-3 8i; progress to full swings. Define acceptable contact.

blocks.name: Long-approach sample
blocks.instructions: Randomize 5i, 6i and 4H (as appropriate to target distance). Use natural committed swings. Record carry, lateral deviation and club; do not chase maximum distance.

blocks.name: Transfer
blocks.instructions: Three simulated par-3s at varied distances; one ball per hole, no mulligans.

blocks.name: Diary
blocks.instructions: Record contact success, sample sizes, misses, and one takeaway.

success_criteria: Record at least 10 long-approach shots with carry and lateral deviation
Log contact quality for a 10-shot randomized iron sample
Record GIR and decision/execution notes for three simulated holes
Take the two-minute arrival pause and choose the intention. Success does not require feeling calm or hitting the first ball perfectly.
sessions.process_commitment: Choose the target, commit, and swing without steering.

sessions.title: Putting baseline: clock, shelf and lag
sessions.purpose: Measure putting across flat, sloped and long distances

blocks.name: Warm-up + arrival
blocks.instructions:
First 2 minutes — arrival routine:
30 seconds: Feel your feet; notice tension and your GREEN/YELLOW/RED state without judging it.
60 seconds: Breathe naturally. When expectations show up, acknowledge them and return attention to breathing.
30 seconds: Set the intention: “Some shots will miss. Choose, commit, then give the next shot my attention.”
Remaining 3 minutes — physical warm-up: Roll easy putts to establish green speed.

blocks.name: Clock baseline
blocks.instructions: Use your established clock routine at familiar distances inside 15 ft; note distances, positions, attempts and makes. Keep the routine unchanged.

blocks.name: Shelf challenge
blocks.instructions: Choose uphill, downhill and cross-slope putts; record starting distance, finish distance and read versus pace error.

blocks.name: Nine-hole putting course
blocks.instructions: Nine varied first putts, including at least three involving the shelf; hole out each, no do-overs; record 3-putts.

blocks.name: Diary
blocks.instructions: Capture make rates by distance, lag leave distance, 3-putts and one observation.

success_criteria: Record make/attempt counts by tested distance
Complete nine-hole putting course and count three-putts
Record at least three shelf putts with leave distances
Take the two-minute arrival pause and choose the intention. Success does not require feeling calm or hitting the first ball perfectly.
sessions.process_commitment: Treat every putt as information; finish each hole.

sessions.title: Driver reliability and course decisions
sessions.purpose: Build playable driver pattern and separate decisions from execution

blocks.name: Warm-up + arrival
blocks.instructions:
First 2 minutes — arrival routine:
30 seconds: Feel your feet; notice tension and your GREEN/YELLOW/RED state without judging it.
60 seconds: Breathe naturally. When expectations show up, acknowledge them and return attention to breathing.
30 seconds: Set the intention: “Some shots will miss. Choose, commit, then give the next shot my attention.”
Remaining 5 minutes — physical warm-up: Wedges and mid irons, then a few relaxed driver swings.

blocks.name: Driver corridor
blocks.instructions: Hit 12 drivers to a realistic landing corridor. Record playable/not, carry/total if available, starting direction and major miss.

blocks.name: Simulator decision challenge
blocks.instructions: Play 4–5 holes. Before each consequential shot choose club, target and safe miss. No mulligans. Record decision quality separately from execution.

blocks.name: Diary
blocks.instructions: Record playable-drive rate, penalties, decision notes and next priority.

success_criteria: Record 12 driver outcomes and playable corridor definition
Evaluate at least five consequential decisions before judging outcomes
Separate decision errors from execution errors
Take the two-minute arrival pause and choose the intention. Success does not require feeling calm or hitting the first ball perfectly.
sessions.process_commitment: Decide first, then trust the swing.

sessions.title: Short game, recovery and pressure transfer
sessions.purpose: Improve missed-green recovery and test course-like variability

blocks.name: Warm-up + arrival
blocks.instructions:
First 2 minutes — arrival routine:
30 seconds: Feel your feet; notice tension and your GREEN/YELLOW/RED state without judging it.
60 seconds: Breathe naturally. When expectations show up, acknowledge them and return attention to breathing.
30 seconds: Set the intention: “Some shots will miss. Choose, commit, then give the next shot my attention.”
Remaining 3 minutes — physical warm-up: Easy chips to establish contact and landing spots.

blocks.name: Chip and pitch variability
blocks.instructions: Alternate landing areas and trajectories. Record 10 chip proximity outcomes from a defined lie.

blocks.name: Bunker / difficult lie
blocks.instructions: If bunker available, attempt 10 greenside escapes; otherwise use rough/tight/uneven lies and mark bunker baseline pending.

blocks.name: Nine-ball up-and-down challenge
blocks.instructions: Play nine varied recovery positions, one ball each, hole out; count pars saved and costly mishits.

blocks.name: Diary and gratitude
blocks.instructions: Record proximity, escapes, up-and-downs, one lesson and one thing appreciated.

success_criteria: Record 10 chip outcomes with a defined starting lie
Record bunker or difficult-lie results without conflating them
Complete nine up-and-down attempts and count successes
Take the two-minute arrival pause and choose the intention. Success does not require feeling calm or hitting the first ball perfectly.
sessions.process_commitment: A miss is a new problem to solve, not a reason to be frustrated.
